request.deadline: Period of delivery is instant as part of on-chain enactment
deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution of reimbursement upon governance action enactment
request.recipient: Ikigai Info governance action submitter / intended recipient; exact address not stated in document
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the Ikigai Info governance action deposit and claimed lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury to reimburse a lost 100,000 ADA governance action deposit plus 3,000 ADA for claimed lost staking rewards.
The original Ikigai Info governance action was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork and was symbolic in nature.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering the 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposer says there was significant community sentiment at the time that the deposit should be reimbursed because the submitter was an early pioneer of Cardano governance.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that action was not approved.
The proposal states there are no costs or expenses associated with the withdrawal beyond the reimbursement amount.
The proposal states there are no circumstances under which the withdrawal might be refunded to the Cardano Treasury.
The proposal states the recipient has not previously received treasury funds.
The proposal states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal includes an external Adastat governance reference that can be checked for the referenced governance action.

summary: The document asks for 103,000 ADA to reimburse a claimed unrecoverable 100,000 ADA Info action deposit plus 3,000 ADA in staking rewards, with most key justification claims asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
